---
title: Get started
---

## Requirements

Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) 1.5 or newer. You do not need Node.js or Playwright to use this extension.

The commands below install the published 0.1.0 release. The `main` branch is currently development version 0.1.9, preparing for 0.2.0. To try the development version, replace `@v0.1.0` with `@main`.

## Create a presentation

Run this in a terminal and follow the prompts to choose a directory:

```sh
quarto use template gavinsimpson/quarto-aarhus@v0.1.0
```

Open the generated `.qmd` file, replace the example metadata and content, then preview it:

```sh
quarto preview my-presentation.qmd
```

Use the filename created in your project in place of `my-presentation.qmd`.

To add the format to an existing project instead:

```sh
quarto add gavinsimpson/quarto-aarhus@v0.1.0
```

## Configure your deck

```yaml
---
title: "My presentation"
format: aarhus-revealjs
author:
  - name: Jane Doe
    affiliations: Department Name
    email: jane-doe@dept.au.dk
    orcid: 0000-0000-0000-0000  # Placeholder: replace with your own ORCID
presenter:
  name: Jane Doe
  title: Associate Professor
  institute: Department Name
event: Research seminar
aarhus:
  colour: dark-blue
  aspect-ratio: "16:9"
  orcid-colour: brand
  section-style: plain
  end-slide: logo  # none, logo, peto, or wordmark
---
```

Use `##` headings for slides and `#` headings for section dividers. `author` describes title-slide authors; `presenter` supplies only footer details.

## Render and share

```sh
quarto render my-presentation.qmd
```

Share the generated HTML and its companion files. To produce one self-contained HTML file, use:

```yaml
format:
  aarhus-revealjs:
    embed-resources: true
```

For PDF, open the HTML in Chrome with `?print-pdf` appended to its URL, then print to PDF with background graphics enabled. A browser's normal print dialog without Reveal's print mode is not the same layout.

See [fonts and portable output](reference.qmd#fonts-and-portable-output) before embedding AU fonts. The [starter source](downloads/template.qmd) provides examples you can copy.
